facts.text: The hotel occupies the Zifeng Tower, which soars nearly 450 meters high.
facts.excerpt: the InterContinental Nanjing occupies the iconic Zifeng Tower, soaring nearly 450 meters high

facts.text: The tower was designed by the architectural firm SOM, led by Adrian Smith.
facts.excerpt: Designed by SOM—the world-renowned architectural firm led by Adrian Smith

facts.text: The tower's exterior has a triangular glass curtain wall that spirals upward like dragon scales.
facts.excerpt: Its exterior features a groundbreaking triangular glass curtain wall that spirals upward like dragon scales.

facts.text: The hotel is on Gulou Square in Nanjing's Gulou District.
facts.excerpt: The hotel enjoys a prime location at Gulou Square in Gulou District

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Gulou Park, Xuanwu Lake, Nanjing University, Southeast University and Jiming Temple.
facts.excerpt: is walking distance to Dazhongting, Gulou Park, Xuanwu Lake, Nanjing University, Southeast University, and Jiming Temple.

facts.text: Nearby attractions include the Ming Dynasty City Wall, 1912 Bar Street, Shiziqiao Food Street and Xinjiekou Commercial Street.
facts.excerpt: surrounded by bustling attractions including Xuanwu Lake, Jimi Temple, 1912 Bar Street, the Ming Dynasty City Wall, Hunan Road Shiziqiao Food Street, and Xinjiekou Commercial Street

facts.text: Xuanwu Lake park is a former imperial garden whose culture dates back about 2,300 years.
facts.excerpt: Xuanwu Lake park is the largest imperial garden of China, and the largest remaining Chinese royal garden and city park of the south of Yangzi river. Culture of Xuanwu Lake could date back to two thousand and three hundred years ago

facts.text: Rooms have French windows and spa-like bathrooms with a separate shower and bathtub.
facts.excerpt: French windows, spa-like bathrooms with separate shower and bathtub, and premium toiletries and amenities

facts.text: Classic Rooms start at 42 square meters.
facts.excerpt: Room Size:  42 sq. m. – 48 sq. m.

facts.text: Some rooms and suites come with lake views and lounge access.
facts.excerpt:
Premium Rooms may include:

- Lake View
- Lounge Access

facts.text: 78 Prime Seafood & Steakhouse is the highest dining venue in Jiangsu province.
facts.excerpt: This high class and contemporary fine dining establishment is the highest dining venue of Jiangsu province.

facts.text: Summit Chinese Restaurant on the 76th floor serves classic Huai Yang dishes.
facts.excerpt: Our chefs skillfully prepare classic Huai Yang dishes.

facts.text: Prime Bar on the 78th floor has a 360-degree view over Xuanwu Lake and Zijin Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Prime Bar located on the 78th floor. It offers a 360° panoramic view, overlooking the beautiful scenery of Nanjing, such as Xuanwu Lake and Zijin Mountain.

facts.text: Sky Bar Lounge on the 45th floor has an outdoor viewing platform with panoramic skyline views.
facts.excerpt: Its outdoor viewing platform offers panoramic Nanjing skyline views perfect for photos, day or night.

facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Water type: Heated pool

facts.text: The hotel has indoor and outdoor pools.
facts.excerpt: swim in our indoor and outdoor pools

facts.text: The hotel's spa is Touch Spa.
facts.excerpt: indulge in treatment at Touch Spa

facts.text: Self parking is complimentary for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary daily self parking

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at InterContinental Nanjing.

facts.text: Guests under 18 cannot check in alone and must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
facts.excerpt: Guests under the age of 18 are not allowed to check in alone and must be accompanied by a parent/guardian.

facts.text: The hotel is about 42 kilometers from Nanjing Lukou International Airport.
